title: Equal derived Koszul maps have equal top evaluations modulo the ideal
statement: Let A be commutative with HasDerivedCategory(ModuleCat A), I an ideal, r natural, f:Fin r -> A with span(range f)=I, and E its integer-extended Koszul complex [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex, def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology]. If z,w:E -> single(A,-r) have equal images under DerivedCategory.Q [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], their top components, transported through extendXIso and singleObjXSelf, have equal evaluations modulo I on every wedge of r free-module vectors. No Koszul-regularity or augmentation is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 48.15.5, finite-free Koszul resolution computation; explicit chain-map/homotopy glue for the local calculation

proof.text: Finite exterior bases give projective natural-number terms. The extension by zero is K-projective by the Mathlib instance for integer extensions of projective chain complexes.
Naturality of quotientCompQhIso transports equality of Q-maps to Qh-maps. Reflect using Qh_map_bijective.injective and extract a homotopy by HomotopyCategory.homotopyOfEq.

At degree -r, Homotopy.comm has no target-differential term. If r=0 the source term in degree 1 is zero. If r=n+1, extend_d_eq transports the remaining term to a functional applied after koszulBoundary at n.

Use ExteriorAlgebra.boundary_wedge from Sheaf.RingTheory.KoszulGeneratorChainMap (the shared proved contraction helper of new-q2-koszul-generator-chain-map). Its coefficients lie in span(range f)=I. Linearity makes the homotopy contribution lie in I. Reduction modulo I kills it, proving equal top evaluations.

proof_origin.place: Q2 writes the chain-map and homotopy glue using Mathlib; the contraction computation is that of Tags 0BQY and 0BQZ. Returned-delivery repair: reuse the chain-map module’s proved boundary_wedge instead of duplicating its proof.

mathlib_searches.results: ProjectiveResolution.liftHomotopyZeroOne_comp, liftHomotopyZeroSucc and generic homotopy-cofiber extensionality results; none gives the Koszul top evaluation modulo the ideal.
Qh_map_bijective reflects equality for K-projective sources; homotopyOfEq extracts a homotopy. Homotopy.comm and extend_d_eq give the component formula. No exact Koszul evaluation theorem.

from.place: Proof of the diagonal Koszul calculation: generator-independent normalized Ext identification, Equal derived Koszul maps have equal top evaluations modulo the ideal

lean.statement:
theorem koszul_derived_top_evaluation_eq
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1} (ModuleCat.{u} A)]
    (I : Ideal A) (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I)
    (z w : (koszulComplex A r f).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat ⟶
      (CochainComplex.singleFunctor (ModuleCat A) (-(r : ℤ))).obj (ModuleCat.of A A))
    (heq : DerivedCategory.Q.map z = DerivedCategory.Q.map w) :
    ∀ v : Fin r → (Fin r →₀ A),
      Ideal.Quotient.mk I
        ((HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (-(r : ℤ))
          (ModuleCat.of A A)).hom
          (z.f (-(r : ℤ)) (((koszulComplex A r f).extendXIso
            ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat (i := r) rfl).inv
              (exteriorPower.ιMulti A r v)))) =
      Ideal.Quotient.mk I
        ((HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (-(r : ℤ))
          (ModuleCat.of A A)).hom
          (w.f (-(r : ℤ)) (((koszulComplex A r f).extendXIso
            ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat (i := r) rfl).inv
              (exteriorPower.ιMulti A r v))))
